newsitem.title: USA: Dole scores victory in tiny N.H. towns.
newsitem.headline: Dole scores victory in tiny N.H. towns.

text.p: Republican presidential candidate Bob Dole scored a symbolic victory Tuesday in two tiny New Hampshire towns that traditionally count the first ballots in the United States.

Voters in the communities of Dixville Notch and Hart's Location gave Dole a win over President Clinton by a margin of 31 to 20 votes, election officials said. Reform Party candidate Ross Perot received 5 votes and Libertarian Party candidate Harry Browne 3 votes.
Pre-election surveys project that Clinton will win the state of New Hampshire.
The two villages in New Hampshire's northern White Mountains take advantage of a state election law that allows communities to close the polls after all registered voters have cast their ballots.
